title.en: Does the infrastructure page name a country project?
title.zh: 基建页点名了某个国家工程吗？

description.en: No. It maps pipeline length and remote diesel power to published models. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not add a national project page without a source.
description.zh: 没有。它把管路长度和偏远柴油动力对照到已公布型号。没有来源时，河北品锦机械不另写国家工程页。

h1.en: Does the infrastructure page name a country project?
h1.zh: 基建页点名了某个国家工程吗？

directAnswer.en: No. The Xingtai infrastructure page from Hebei Pinjin Machinery tells you to map pipeline length to listed horizontal distance, review diesel models for remote sites, and match delivery capacity to the planned pour. The longest horizontal figure it cites is 900 m on Electric 80. There is no country, no ministry project and no completed-volume claim on that page. This note will not invent one.
directAnswer.zh: 没有。邢台河北品锦机械的基建页让你把管路长度对照目录水平距离，为偏远工地核对柴油型号，并按计划浇筑量匹配输送量。它引用的最长水平数字是电动80的 900 m。那一页没有国家、没有部委项目，也没有完工方量。本说明不会编一个。

heading.en: What you can still decide from the catalogue
heading.zh: 你仍然能从目录决定什么

body.en: You can decide the family: electric if the grid can feed the motor, diesel if it cannot. You can decide the row by metres, m³/h and aggregate. Electric 80, HBT8018, Diesel 120, LZ-80, LZ-60 and Diesel 30–60 are the infrastructure-facing tables already cited on this site. A buyer’s country is an inquiry field for shipping, not a reason to create an engineering case study.
body.zh: 你能决定系列：电网供得起电机就用电动，供不起就用柴油。你能按米数、m³/h 和骨料决定行。电动80、HBT8018、柴油120、LZ-80、LZ-60 和柴油30–60 是本站已经引用的基建向表格。买家的国家是发货询盘栏，不是编写工程案例的理由。

heading.en: The highway image is context, not a case
heading.zh: 公路图片是场景，不是案例

body.en: The published photograph is described as equipment on highway infrastructure work. It does not print a chainage, a contract volume or a client. Do not ask the factory to confirm a job that the page does not name.
body.zh: 已发布的照片被描述为公路基建上的设备作业。它没有印桩号、合同方量或业主。不要让工厂确认页面上没有名字的工程。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Send metres, stone, output and power. Omit the country project title. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请发米数、石子、输送量和动力。不要附国家工程标题。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Will a market page replace this match?
question.zh: 市场页能代替这次对照吗？

answer.en: Market pages, where they exist, describe export matching to catalogue parameters. They are not local warehouses and not named jobs. The pump is still chosen from the model table.
answer.zh: 如果存在市场页，它们写的是按目录参数匹配出口。它们不是当地仓库，也不是具名工程。泵仍然按型号表来选。

question.en: Is 900 m available in every country?
question.zh: 900 m 在每个国家都可用吗？

answer.en: 900 m is a catalogue cell on Electric 80, valid only with that page’s power and aggregate. Geography does not change the cell.
answer.zh: 900 m 是电动80上的目录格，只在该页的动力和骨料成立时使用。地理不改变这个格子。

answer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery, Renze Industrial Park, Xingtai, via /contact.
answer.zh: 河北品锦机械，邢台任泽工业园区，通过 /contact。
